notes:
PD: mid-market B2B search/summarization platform for developer docs and customer support. Initial ask: reduce time-to-first-byte and per-conversation cost. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API for quick integration, then a Dedicated pool if throughput and cost targets met.

Key quotes: "We need predictable unit economics for chat sessions; cost per active user drives pricing model." — Head of Product.

Security: SOC2 in place; require SSO/SAML + KMS integration for encryption-in-transit and at-rest. Data residency for EU enterprise customers is a hard requirement for two large prospects.

POC scope: 3-week POC to test Hosted API latency under production prompt distributions, then a pilot Dedicated configuration for 2 GPU nodes (NVIDIA A10/A100 mix) to evaluate unit cost at scale. POC will include a baseline run with no caching, then iterative runs with prefix caching + per-customer KV cache.

Cost conversation: pricing sensitivity around token costs and sustained throughput; want modeling of batching + caching + quantization impact on $/k token. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations and a workshop on quantization profiles.

Ops notes: prefer routing by region (NA primary, EU failover) and automatic fallback to cheaper model variant when load spikes. Must have audit logs + 90-day retention for debug, with option to extend for enterprise.

CRM shorthand: demo 2025-02-14 — product walkthrough (Jordan + Mei). POC kickoff 2025-03-03 (internal infra sizing needed). Finance team flagged ARR cap; procurement timeline mid-June.

Next actions: schedule 2-hr cost optimization workshop with Redwood Optimize + runtime engineer, deliver POC resource plan and estimated cost delta table (baseline vs batching vs caching vs 8-bit quantization).
